title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
title_zh: 超越 Self-Consistency：测试时递归自我改进
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.
abstract_zh: 现有测试时方法主要依赖 Self-Consistency（自洽性）：针对无标签问题独立生成多份解答，再通过多数投票选出答案或构造训练目标。这种做法在推理时未能复用先前的推理过程，在训练时还可能强化错误的多数答案。本文提出无需标签的 Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement（TT-RSI）框架，由两个相互促进的组件构成：In-Context RSI 将上一轮的完整解答作为参考，让模型自主决定是否以及如何利用它，并重新解答同一问题；In-Weight RSI 将逐轮改进的结果蒸馏到模型权重中，使模型有机会跳出初始的错误多数，并在理论上让首轮解答逼近无限轮迭代改进的极限。更新后的模型不仅能给出更好的首轮解答，也能更有效地修正解答，为后续训练提供更高质量的参考。实验显示，TT-RSI 的平均准确率较基础模型提升 13.89%；在相同的测试时计算预算下，较表现最强的 Self-Consistency 方法提升 4.79%。
key_points_zh: 独立采样加多数投票无法利用已有推理；当多数答案恰好错误时，还可能把错误变成训练目标。
In-Context RSI 每轮参考上一轮的完整解答，而非只看最终答案，由模型决定保留哪些推理、修正哪些错误。
In-Weight RSI 将逐轮改进蒸馏进模型权重，改善首轮解答和后续修正能力，为下一轮训练提供更好的参考。
TT-RSI 的平均准确率较基础模型提升 13.89%；在相同测试时计算预算下，较最强的 Self-Consistency 方法提升 4.79%。
